content:
Attach the metal parts to the Nozzle-Seal-holder first, then you have better grip and less chance of cutting yourself.

Props to Dave to pointing this out already.
They went on ok for me as long as I hold the metal end flat side and focus on pinching/guiding the sleeve around the bent end to prevent puncture.
i mounted the plates to the brackets ( see next  step) that way I had the bracket to hold while sliding the seal on - much easier. almost no risk of cutting yourself

1. Cut-resistant glove for one hand.
2. Nitrile glove for the other hand.
3. LOTS of IPA
4. Spare towel to catch the overflow of IPA
Put the end of the torx driver through the hole to push against, and, as iKriz said, hold by the flat side.

This step is made MUCH easier if you have a pair of parallel jaw pliers, or something like a Knipex pliers-wrench. You just hold the flat part with the pliers. Regular needle-nose pliers will _not_ work. They really need to be parallel jaw pliers.
do not hold them like in the image, but flat between your fingers, helps to slide/push the silicone over from the bent end
They are that sharp.. they cut trough the silicone...

replies.content: I cut one through the silicone

content: I used an IPA spray. Put the end of the spray tip inside the sleeve and added just a drop. Makes it soooo much easier. But damn is it really too much to ask to get this alredy assembled?

Omg.  I thought I’d loose my mind.  I tried for over 10 minutes to get the first sleeve on; no joy. A cotton swab with IPA helped a little but not enough. 
Thankfully I had a syringe I could use.  I used 91% IPA and filled the sleeve with it.  It became so frictionless I had to be careful not to push the clip through the silicone.  Here I used my thumb and index finger to continuously push it over the bend.  I got all four done in a few minutes

replies.content: Yup, I used an old kids tylenol syringe - a little squirt inside each sleeve and it slipped right on. Thanks for the idea!

content: A drop of isopropyl alcohol helps, like with the wipe blocks.
